description: This is a PHP class file defining the outlook email account editing view within the SuiteCRM project. It includes a custom class OutboundEmailAccountsViewEdit that extends a base ViewEdit class, overriding the display method to assign an 'is_admin' variable to the view template.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccountsViewEdit
classes.description: Custom view class for editing outbound email account settings in SuiteCRM, extending the core ViewEdit class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the default display method to assign 'is_admin' status of the current user to the view, then calls the parent display method.
